instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after actor evidence exists and an independent critic artifact approves or waives completion.

features.description: The trace Eval roadmap has verified repo facts, industry-informed requirements, data contracts, phase boundaries, validation commands, and first-wave AI assistant scope.
steps: Run the strict harness validator for deploy/runbooks/agent-trace-eval-prd.
Confirm root docs remain ignored and the harness lives in a trackable runbook path.
Write a baseline report that maps AI assistant, LangGraph proxy, and RAG trace families to phased implementation and validation gates.
features.notes: ATE-00 passed strict validation, docs-ignore proof, placeholder scan, repo manifest proof, and independent critic review. ATE-01 is unlocked.

features.description: An authorized Eval user can list, filter, open, and score tenant-scoped AI assistant traces through a stable backend API backed by durable trace tables.
steps: Apply the local development migration or run a migration dry check that creates assistant trace, span, event, and score storage.
Call the list and detail APIs as a user with Eval trace permission and verify only that user's tenant data is returned.
Submit a score or feedback item and verify it is stored against the trace without exposing raw secrets or cross-tenant data.
features.notes: ATE-01 added additive trace tables, tenant-scoped Eval list/detail/score API, assistant-only first-wave gating, and focused tests. Runtime capture remains ATE-02.

features.description: AI assistant non-streaming and streaming chat requests persist a redacted application trace with run lifecycle, model, tool, RAG/context, usage, timing, status, and error evidence without adding user-visible agent latency.
steps: Run a controlled assistant chat path that emits run_started and a terminal run_finished or run_error event.
Verify a trace record is persisted with session_id/thread_id, run_id, tenant_id, user_id, request_id, trace_family assistant, and terminal status. Treat source_kind as a historical alias only.
Verify child spans or events capture model call, tool call, context/RAG, usage, latency, and error fields while redacting credentials and bounding large content.
Verify a slow or failing trace writer does not delay first stream event, final non-stream response, or assistant run status updates.
features.notes: ATE-02 added bounded non-blocking assistant trace capture for non-stream and streaming flows, redacted/bounded payload handling, deterministic terminal event conflict behavior, failure tolerance, streaming-first regression tests, and latency guard tests proving trace persistence does not delay first stream event, final non-stream response, or assistant run status updates. ATE-03 is unlocked.

features.description: The frontend exposes an Eval module with an Assistant trace explorer, detail timeline, metadata panes, score workflow, and guarded future tabs for LangGraph proxy and RAG trace families.
steps: Open /eval as an authorized user and verify the Assistant tab loads trace list filters and empty/loading/error states.
Open a trace detail view and verify timeline spans, request/run/session metadata, usage, latency, errors, and redacted previews render without layout overflow.
Submit or view score feedback and verify desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 keyboard and visual checks pass.
features.notes: ATE-03 added protected /eval navigation and route, assistant trace list filters, redacted trace detail timeline, score display/submission, guarded LangGraph Proxy and RAG tabs, unauthorized browser coverage, desktop/mobile screenshots, and e2e evidence. Root pnpm -C web commands fail in this Codex runtime before scripts run due pnpm 11.x lockfile config mismatch; equivalent project-version commands from web/ using pnpm@10.33.0 passed. ATE-04 is unlocked for whole-demand regression.

features.description: The first-wave AI assistant trace Eval feature passes whole-demand regression and leaves clear handoff contracts for LangGraph proxy trace and RAG trace phases.
steps: Run backend, assistant runtime, frontend, browser, privacy, and strict harness validation for completed ATE-F001 through ATE-F004 items.
Verify existing dashboard request traces, assistant sessions, assistant runs, and streaming chat behavior still pass their targeted regression checks.
Write terminal handoff notes that name the remaining LangGraph proxy and RAG trace source families, inherited schema fields, and blocked external dependencies.
features.notes: ATE-04 cleared the broad assistant-service lint baseline, passed backend whole-demand pytest with 33 passed and 2 skipped after post-review trace hardening, passed frontend lint/type/e2e, passed example config validation, passed strict harness validation, and documented LangGraph Proxy Trace plus RAG Trace handoff contracts. First-wave AI Assistant trace Eval is complete.
